answer: Anyone wanting 58 effective identities must lock that capital for 56 epochs and keep it locked through every garden audit. The voyage schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the tide checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 56 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 12 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
